'''June 2001 Ottawa tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada on 3 June 2001. [[Thomas Dowling]] won it. It is known from Thomas Dowling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2405">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-03-ottawa-canada-03-06-01d2405/ ottawa-canada-03-06-01], DeckTech (Thomas "COTEB" Dowling, 3 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-03-ottawa-canada-03-06-01d2405/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Ottawa, Ontario, Canada
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' [[Thomas Dowling]]
